name: bluesky_timeline
description: Fetch the Bluesky home timeline as a compact, ref-anchored list. Each post is shown as [bN] @handle with its full text and image/quote markers, and can be replied to or liked by ref. Authentication is handled internally. Call this before bluesky_reply / bluesky_like / bluesky_hydrate_post.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: How many recent posts to fetch (1-50). Default 20.

outputs.description: ref_count and the list of refs.
